known_parity_gaps: GAP-seal-ledger-schema-load: load_seal_schema imports sesslint._resources and json.loads the schema file. This card reads the pin blob in the generator and does not call load_seal_schema. tests/test_seal.py::test_seal_schema_self_consistent calls load_seal_schema and _entry, so it is not covered.
GAP-seal-ledger-duplicate-key: duplicate JSON object keys are refused. Python json.loads keeps the last key.

GAP-seal-ledger-json-number: a JSON number with a fraction, an exponent, or a value outside i64 is refused. Draft 2020-12 treats 1.0 as an integer and Python int is unbounded. Those values are not invented here.
GAP-seal-ledger-emit-refusal: build_entry raises SealError text. emit_entry returns schema reasons and does not copy those sentences.
